structured_output.summary: The change implements Atomics.notify in spec order. It validates the typed array, validates the index, coerces count (undefined becomes +∞, otherwise ToIntegerOrInfinity clamped at 0), and returns +0 for a non-shared buffer. For shared buffers it returns min(count, 0), which is RemoveWaiters on the always-empty waiter list, as the ticket describes. All observable operations (ToIndex, ToNumber on count) happen in spec order with errors propagated by `?`. The WaiterList steps are reduced to comments, which is justified because Kahvi has one agent that can never wait. The 6 remaining test262 failures come from unimplemented Atomics.wait and SharedArrayBuffer.prototype.grow, which are outside this ticket.
